DSP_KNOB_REFERENCE_RATE.doc: The rate a unit-range DSP knob is quoted at (R-058): the rate this desk runs (ruling 2026-09-14). A kernel raises the knob to `REF / sr`, so at this rate the exponent is exactly 1 and the response is bit-for-bit the one cut before the law. Emitted to C as `OMX_DSP_KNOB_REFERENCE_RATE`; the reverb damping and FX-delay tone references `#define` from it.
